repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjM14LaGXrUyBb4bBgf

Four framework cards for hosted knowledge on Turso, for repo:objectstack#1 (area o1-C) to file under this topic — asked on mailbox objectstack#37457 comment 7218675947.

**Maintainer lines (Source: maintainer).** Both said by the maintainer (hotlong) in the cloud #5 project thread, 2026-11-27, and recorded on cloud#4993 comment 7218621399 (`Ruling:` line):
- 11:47Z 「云上需要知识库，用turso」
- 11:50Z 「云端不应该让客户配置向量模型」
Decision cards in the same thread: 11:54Z 「计入现有 AI 额度」, 12:41Z 「按实际成本折算（约 1/50）」 (cloud side, cloud#5137). Plan reviewed by an independent Fable pass (findings cited as R#). Line numbers are objectstack `origin/main` 73d5e347.

Suggested grading: area:ai · domain:server · Feature · p2 (topic; F4 blocks cloud#4993 part 2) — F3 p3.

## F4 — knowledge event sync without the realtime service (blocks cloud#4993 part 2)
- Problem: `service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service-plugin.ts:590-607` subscribes record sync only through `realtime`; without it, it warns and returns. Hosted kernels mount no `realtime` (cloud decided not to take it on for this), so the index builds at boot (`knowledge-service.ts:1386-1391`) and never sees later creates/updates (deletes already have the reap guard, which is realtime-independent).
- What: sync subscribes to the data engine's after-write hooks (as the reap path already does) when `realtime` is absent, or always; one path, no double handling when both exist. The embed call must not sit on the business write's response path (queue/defer).
- Acceptance: a kernel with no realtime service — create and update a record of an indexed object, search finds the new text without a rebuild; with realtime present, each write is synced once; a slow embedder does not delay the write's response.

## F1 — a switch: the knowledge service does not add the embedder section to the `ai` settings page
- Problem: `knowledge-settings-contribution.ts:138-147` adds `embedder_*` fields and `ai/test_embedder` when the `ai` manifest is the bundled one. A host that provides the embedder itself (hosted cloud, cloud#5137) must not offer them. Cloud could dodge it by registering a copied manifest, but that depends on init order and warns every boot (R9).
- What: `KnowledgeServicePluginOptions` switch (e.g. `embedderSettings: false`); when off, no embedder fields, no `test_embedder` action, no warning.
- Acceptance: with the switch off, `ai` manifest has no embedder keys and `test_embedder` answers unknown action; default unchanged.

## F2 — knowledge-turso: shape-check before the three remaining DROPs, and check `knowledge_generation`'s shape
- Problem: on hosted the store shares the environment database with object tables (object table name = object name, `spec/src/system/constants/system-names.ts:299-302`). New-generation tables are already shape-checked before reuse (`turso-adapter.ts:838-850`), but `:625`, `:652`, `:694` DROP by generation-row name without a shape check; and a pre-existing object table named `knowledge_generation` makes `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` a no-op and the store unusable (R4).
- What: the same shape check before those three DROPs (refuse, never drop, a table the store did not make); `ready()` checks `knowledge_generation`'s shape and reports unavailable with the reason. No table prefix (a prefix with characters object names cannot carry trips cloud's v18 verdict tool, `tenant-verdicts.mjs:290-303`, and would force a rebuild on rename).
- Acceptance: an object table with a generation table's name survives a rebuild/drop; a foreign `knowledge_generation` reports unavailable naming it. Cloud reserves the names at publish (cloud#4993 part 2 item 8).

## F3 — search pre-filters by the caller's visible record ids when they fit the record scope
- Problem: hits are re-checked after ranking (`knowledge-service.ts:1442-1458`, factors 5 then 20); a caller who can read few rows (e.g. 20 of 1,000 policies) may get none of their visible answers within 20×topK.
- What: for a non-system caller, per object source, first read the caller's visible ids (as the caller, with the source's `where`, ids only, limit 501). ≤500 (`knowledge-search-scope.ts:42-44`): pass them as a `record` term so the adapter ranks only those (`turso-adapter.ts:516-541`, pgvector likewise). Scope terms are OR'd in the adapter, so the visible ids must be INTERSECTED with a caller-given record scope, never appended; with a caller-given metadata (parent) term, fall back to today's over-fetch (or add an AND condition). >500: today's path. Hits are still re-checked one by one. Count removed hits is still never returned.
- Acceptance: a caller who may read 20 of 1,000 indexed records finds an answer in one of their 20 when it ranks below 20×topK overall; a caller scope of one record stays one record; organization filter unchanged. Note in the PR: this raises recall, it does not cut row reads (no `source_record_id` index, `sql.ts:146`).

repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjM14LaGXrUyBb4bBgf

Follow-up framework cards for knowledge as a platform feature (not just one policy library), for repo:objectstack#1 (area o1-C) to file under this topic next to F1–F4 (#37954–#37957).

**Maintainer line (Source: maintainer).** Said by the maintainer (hotlong) in the cloud #5 project thread, 2026-11-27 13:41Z: 「但是我们作为元数据开发平台，不能只考虑制度库」. Plan section 「平台通用视角」 in https://claude.ai/artifact/Y87cQ9Lzw7Li1VPtp8xZFQ. Line numbers are objectstack `origin/main` as of today.

Why: every search scans every admitted source's whole passage table, up to twice (`turso-adapter.ts` exact scan; `knowledge-service.ts` per-source loop ~:1875, factors 5/20). At 1536-dim float32 a passage is ~7.5 KB, so one question reads ~150 MB at 20k passages and ~1.5 GB at 200k. Policy libraries stay under 20k; ticket history, visit notes, emails and attachment text do not. Industry reference: Salesforce Data 360 and ServiceNow AI Search both run keyword + vector hybrid; Twenty uses no vectors.

## F3 amendment (on #37957) — index `source_record_id` so the pre-filter cuts reads
- `sql.ts:146` indexes only `document_id`. Add `CREATE INDEX <table>_record ON <table>(source_record_id)` in `passageTableDdl` (new generations; existing tables get it on next build, no migration needed).
- With the index, the ≤500 visible-ids path reads only those records' passages instead of the whole table: the narrow-permission case becomes the cheapest, not the worst. Acceptance adds: with 20 visible of 100k indexed passages, the query plan uses the index (EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN shows `USING INDEX`).
- Measure before raising the 500 cap (`knowledge-search-scope.ts:42-44`); report latency at 500 / 2,000 ids in the PR.

## F5 — hybrid search: an FTS5 keyword leg merged with the vector leg (p3)
- Problem: vector-only misses exact tokens (order numbers, model codes, names).
- What: per passage table an FTS5 shadow table (`tokenize='trigram'`), kept in step with passage writes; search runs both legs and merges with RRF (k=60) before the permission re-check. Verified on local libSQL 0.15 (@libsql/client): trigram matches Chinese terms of ≥3 characters (「住宿标准」「三十天」) but NOT 2-character terms (「出差」 → no hit), and `X-200` unquoted is a syntax error — so: quote the query as a phrase, and for terms <3 characters fall back to `content LIKE '%…%'` on the scoped rows. Turso docs list FTS5 as always-on (https://docs.turso.tech/features/sqlite-extensions.md); pgvector adapter uses Postgres `tsvector` for the same leg.
- Acceptance: a question naming an exact code finds the passage the vector leg alone ranks below topK; a 2-character Chinese term hits; no regression on the brightrule eval set.

## F6 — approximate index for large sources, chosen by size (p3)
- Problem: exact scan is linear; DiskANN (`vector_top_k`) was ruled out because it ranks before the organization filter. On hosted (one organization per database, cloud ADR-0114) that filter is moot.
- What: per source, above a passage threshold (default 20k, option), build a `libsql_vector_idx` and search via `vector_top_k(k × factor)` then the metadata filter + re-check; callers whose visible ids fit the F3 cap keep the exact indexed path. Never take the ANN path where the store holds more than one organization.
- Acceptance: at 200k passages p95 search latency under a stated bound (measure, put the number in the PR); recall@10 vs exact ≥ 0.95 on a sample.

## F7 — objectstack-ai skill guidance for knowledge sources beyond documents (p3)
- What: in `skills/objectstack-ai`, say (a) index long free text only (articles, notes, ticket bodies, extracted attachment text), never numbers or short fields — counts and filters go to query tools; (b) one source per corpus, and agents/skills pass `sourceIds` (already on `search_knowledge`) so a question does not scan every source; (c) attachment text must first land in a text field (file/http source kinds retired in 19, `knowledge-source.zod.ts:130`).

Not in this batch: attachment text extraction into a field (needs its own design with file storage), and moving large sources to a dedicated database (cloud side, after the registry seam from cloud#4993 part 2).
